title: Mixed Signals: Weight-Space Programming for EEG and ECG
abstract: arXiv:2611.13758v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Weight-space programming allows language models to read a trained neural network's weights and edit them. This opens the door to ``training'' by reasoning rather than through gradient descent. Prior work has demonstrated its functionality and promise for game-playing networks and fixing specific failures in language models, even extending to diffusion models. In this work, we present its applicability to models trained on biosignal data, specifically EEG and ECG data. We show that frontier models are not only able to debug specific faults planted in biosignal-based models without being told what these faults are, but are even capable of writing all the weights of a network from scratch, given only the architecture, the task, and a minimal set of training subjects. translated_title: 混合信号：面向脑电图（EEG）与心电图（ECG）的权重空间编程
translated_abstract: 权重空间编程使语言模型能够读取经过训练的神经网络的权重并对其进行编辑。这为通过推理而非梯度下降进行“训练”打开了大门。先前的工作已经证明了该方法在游戏类网络中的功能与前景，以及其在修复语言模型特定故障方面的应用，甚至扩展到了扩散模型。在本工作中，我们展示了该方法在生物信号数据训练的模型上的适用性，特别是脑电图（EEG）和心电图（ECG）数据。我们表明，前沿模型不仅能够在未被告知故障内容的情况下，调试植入生物信号模型中的特定故障，甚至能够在仅给定网络架构、任务以及最少量的训练受试者数据的情况下，从零开始写出网络的全部权重。特别是在其中一组实验中，一个语言模型仅通过推理，就在使用少6倍训练受试者的情况下，达到了与标准梯度下降训练相当的效果。
tldr: 本文首次将权重空间编程应用于脑电图与心电图等生物信号模型，证明语言模型不仅能诊断并修复植入的模型故障，还能仅凭推理从零写出网络全部权重，并以少6倍的训练数据达到与梯度下降训练相当的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper extends weight-space programming to EEG and ECG biosignal models, showing that language models can debug planted faults without being told what they are and write all network weights from scratch, matching standard gradient-descent training with 6× fewer training subjects through reasoning alone.
